title: seseli graveolens
intro: Seseli graveolens, commonly known as Ferula graveolens or asafoetida, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Iran and Afghanistan. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to protect against digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Seseli graveolens include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, making it a popular remedy for colds, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Seseli graveolens include coumarins, terpenes, and sulfur-containing compounds, such as asafoetida, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
